d:
"Every rescue can change the course of a dog's life. At Villalobos Rescue Center, Tia Torres and her team take on some deeply moving dog rescue cases, helping abandoned, stray, injured and sick pit bulls get the care they desperately need. Behind every pit bull rescue is a story of hardship, survival and the chance to experience a better life.
Watch Pit Bulls & Parolees, Season 9, Episodes 20, 11, 18, 2, 16, 19, 5 and 9, on Animal Planet India."
